# 4.55 Fifty-fifth assembly district.
All of the following territory constitutes the 55th assembly district:
(1) OUTAGAMIE COUNTY. That part of Outagamie County consisting of that part of the town of Grand Chute comprising U.S. census tract 10900, block 1020; and tract 11001, blocks 1000, 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006, 1007, 1008, 1009, 1010, 1011, 2004, 2005, 2007, 2008, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 3003, 3004, 3005, 3006, 3007, 3008, 3014, 3015, 3016, and 3017; and tract 11002, block 1037; and tract 12506, blocks 1000, 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006, 1007, 1008, 1009, 1010, 1011, 1012, 1013, 1014, 1015, 1016, 1017, 1018, 1019, 1020, 1021, 1022, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031, 3004, 3008, 3011, 3012, 3013, 3014, 3015, and 3016.
